_comment: Shareholders' equity attributable to owners, in KES, from each company's latest published results (used for P/B = market cap / equity). Hand-entered: update after each annual or half-year report. Format: "SYMBOL": { "equity": 123400000000, "asOf": "2026-06-30", "source": "H1 2026 results" }. Stocks without an entry show P/B as —.
